fields.description:
## Context
Cut the next minor release, 0.11.0, from reviewed main using docs/releasing.md. The current package and latest tag are 0.10.1/v0.10.1. PyPI is immutable; publication must use the dispatch-from-main workflow and its required pypi environment approval. The release date is 2026-08-06. Closed ticket 5ac8-96d1-4691-49a5 is the 0.10.1 release precedent, not active duplicate work.

## Plan
- Work in a fresh worktree based on current origin/main and confirm release prerequisites, identity, recent Gerrit history/rights, and channel state.
- Bump pyproject.toml and every version in server.json to 0.11.0; generate and hand-curate the 0.11.0 CHANGELOG section dated 2026-08-06 and its compare links.
- Run version-lockstep and proportional release preflight: release-specific tests/guards, lint, typecheck, full tests, build, and twine checks.
- Commit with DCO, Change-Id, and rebar-ticket trailer; send through Gerrit and wait for LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with no unresolved comments, then Submit.
- After the bump lands on main, dispatch release.yml from main with version=0.11.0 and obtain the required pypi environment approval; monitor the entire workflow to a terminal result.
- Verify PyPI 0.11.0 plus PEP 740 provenance, the v0.11.0 GitHub tag/release and artifacts, MCP Registry 0.11.0, and the Homebrew tap bump (trigger autobump if useful).
- Install nava-rebar[mcp]==0.11.0 from PyPI in the distribution-channel environment and run the packaged post-publication probe.
- Record receipts and results on this ticket, then close it only after all acceptance criteria are met.

## File impact
- pyproject.toml — package version bump
- server.json — MCP manifest/package version bump
- CHANGELOG.md — curated 0.11.0 release notes and compare links

## Rollback / failure policy
Before publish, stop on any failed guard, review, or CI vote and remediate through a new Gerrit patchset. After publish, PyPI cannot be replaced: if the artifact is bad, yank 0.11.0, de-list its GitHub Release, and cut a fixed patch version; do not overwrite artifacts or retag published content.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] pyproject.toml declares version 0.11.0.
- [ ] server.json top-level version is 0.11.0.
- [ ] Every server.json packages[].version is 0.11.0.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md contains a hand-curated 0.11.0 section dated 2026-08-06.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has a fresh Unreleased section and correct 0.11.0 compare links.
- [ ] `python scripts/release_guards.py version-lockstep --version 0.11.0 --pyproject pyproject.toml --server-json server.json` exits 0.
- [ ] Release-specific guard and workflow tests exit 0.
- [ ] `make lint` exits 0 under the worktree virtualenv.
- [ ] `make typecheck` exits 0 under the worktree virtualenv.
- [ ] `make test` exits 0 under the worktree virtualenv.
- [ ] `python -m build` produces the 0.11.0 wheel and sdist.
- [ ] `python -m twine check dist/*` exits 0 for the built artifacts.
- [ ] The release commit contains DCO sign-off, a Gerrit Change-Id, and this rebar-ticket trailer.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Gerrit records LLM-Review +1 on the release change.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Gerrit records Verified +1 on the release change.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Gerrit has no unresolved comments on the release change.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Gerrit submits the release change and the resulting commit is on main.
- [ ] [operator-attested] release.yml is dispatched from main with version input 0.11.0.
- [ ] [operator-attested] The required pypi environment deployment is approved.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Every required release.yml job completes successfully.
- [ ] PyPI serves nava-rebar 0.11.0.
- [ ] `gh attestation verify` validates the published 0.11.0 artifact against navapbc/rebar.
- [ ] GitHub tag v0.11.0 resolves to the released main commit.
- [ ] GitHub Release v0.11.0 is marked Latest.
- [ ] GitHub Release v0.11.0 attaches the 0.11.0 wheel and sdist.
- [ ] MCP Registry reports io.github.navapbc/rebar version 0.11.0.
- [ ] Homebrew tap Formula/rebar.rb points to the 0.11.0 PyPI sdist URL.
- [ ] Homebrew tap Formula/rebar.rb SHA-256 equals the PyPI 0.11.0 sdist digest.
- [ ] A fresh channel install of nava-rebar[mcp]==0.11.0 passes scripts/probe_rebar.py with zero failures.
- [ ] Release receipts, any exceptions, and the rollback disposition are recorded on this ticket.
